notes.title: This game may be removed from STEAMSTORE!
notes.content:
I know that my most sold game perhaps shouldnt be removed... I also know that many of you enjoyed this game as well. I must tell you the truth tough, I am not proud of this game.
I used premade graphics when making it and now the game just look souless. So I kinda of think that it looks and feels bad. I also feel like this game doesnt represent what KG is all about.

I am not mad, I am just trying to improve and thats the reason I am also removing Empire IDLE. I kinda want to make games that you will spend hundreds of hours playing like its Greed Knights.

I also plan a remade of every other game of mines as I remade Glad IDLE. 

Questions:

Will I loose my game I paid for?
Answer: - No! You wont It will remain in your library! and you can still play it whenever you want!

What will exactly happen?
Answer: - The game will be removed from the store It wont be sold anymore!

I want to make Better Games. 

I want to make Games that looks and plays good and I am studyeing Hard for it!

Thank you for your patience!
